Comment "WISH" and I'll send you Kevin Trudeau's 14 Your Wish Is Your Command audios. Free.

Kevin Trudeau says he was once in a packed room in Aspen, Colorado, watching one of the country's best-known motivational speakers work a crowd.

The guy wouldn't stop swearing from the stage. Then he turned it on the audience, needling them until they started cursing back at him, louder and louder.

Kevin sat there and recognized it instantly. He'd learned the real version of it inside the Brotherhood years before: break someone down first, then they'll follow you anywhere.
